query: UPDATE envelopes SET engine_state = $4, version = version + 1, status = $5, subject = $6, message = $7, expires_at = $8, reminder_policy = $9, signing_options = $10, seal_profile = $11, sent_at = $12, completed_at = $13, voided_at = $14, void_reason = $15 WHERE account_id = $1 AND id = $2 AND version = $3 RETURNING version
